title: The Missed Reunion
content:
Paris welcomed Sneha with its cool breeze and clear blue sky.

A few hours after landing, Sneha and her teammates completed the immigration formalities and reached the hotel arranged by their company.

After such a long journey, everyone wanted to rest before the official meetings scheduled for the next day.

But Sneha couldn't.

For five long years...

She had dreamed of this moment.

Now that she was finally in the same city as Siddu, waiting until tomorrow felt impossible.

Unable to calm the excitement in her heart, she quickly freshened up, changed into a simple blue dress, and quietly slipped out of the hotel.

Without informing anyone...

She headed straight to Siddu's office.

________________________________________

The magnificent glass building stood proudly against the Paris skyline.

Sneha stopped for a moment outside the entrance.

A gentle smile appeared on her face.

"So, this is where you've been all these years..."

Taking a deep breath, she walked inside.

She approached the reception desk.

"Excuse me..."

"I'd like to meet Mr. Siddhartha."

The receptionist smiled politely.

"I'm sorry, ma'am."

"Mr. Siddhartha is on leave today."

Sneha blinked in surprise.

"On leave...?"

"Yes, ma'am."

"He won't be coming to the office today."

For a moment, she simply stood there.

The excitement that had carried her all the way from the hotel quietly faded into confusion.

She thanked the receptionist and slowly walked back outside.

Standing before the towering glass building, she looked up at it once more.

"I finally came all the way here..."

"And you're not here..."

She let out a quiet sigh.

________________________________________

Just then...

Her phone began to ring.

It was Yagnesh.

"Sneha!"

"Where did you disappear?"

"We've been looking for you."

Sneha hesitated for a moment before replying,

"I just wanted to explore Paris a little."

"I'll be back soon."

Yagnesh laughed.

"If you're already outside..."

"Find a nice café."

"Send me the location."

"I'll join you."

Sneha smiled.

"Okay."

"I'll text you."

The call ended.

Almost immediately...

Another call appeared on her screen.

Shreya Calling...

Sneha answered without hesitation.

"Hello, Shreya."

"I need to tell you something important."

"Can we meet?"

"There's a café near Siddu's office."

"I'll send you the location."

"Sure."

"I'll be there."

After ending the call, Sneha shared the same location with Yagnesh and slowly walked toward the café.

________________________________________

A few minutes later...

Shreya arrived.

The two of them ordered coffee and sat near the window.

Sneha looked at her curiously.

"You said you wanted to tell me something important."

Shreya nodded.

"I did."

She took a slow breath.

"Siddu..."

"...left for India this morning."

Sneha froze.

"What...?"

"He went to India?"

Shreya nodded.

"Yes."

Sneha couldn't understand what was happening.

"Our company's meeting is tomorrow."

"He personally approved this project."

"Then why would he suddenly leave?"

"Isn't he interested in meeting me?"

"Or..."

"Is he avoiding me?"

Every question carried more disappointment than the last.

Shreya quietly watched her.

"I don't know why he left."

"But knowing Siddu..."

"He never makes a decision without a reason."

Sneha slowly lowered her head.

She wanted to believe those words.

But her heart had already begun imagining countless possibilities.

________________________________________

Just then...

Yagnesh entered the café.

His eyes searched the room until they found Sneha.

As he walked toward her, his footsteps suddenly slowed.

The woman sitting opposite Sneha...

There was something strangely graceful about her.

Sneha smiled.

"Yagnesh..."

"This is Shreya."

The moment he heard her name...

His expression changed.

So...

This is the woman.

The woman who broke Siddu's heart.

For a brief moment, countless memories of Siddu's pain flashed through his mind.

His brain reminded him of everything Shreya had done.

But when he looked into her eyes...

He didn't see arrogance.

He didn't see pride.

He only saw guilt...

And a sadness that had never completely faded.

His heart and mind pulled him in opposite directions.

After a few silent seconds, he forced a polite smile.

"Nice to meet you."

"I just remembered..."

"I have something important to finish."

"I'll see you both later."

Without waiting for a reply, he quietly turned around and walked away.

Shreya watched him leave with a puzzled expression.

"Did I say something wrong?"

Sneha looked at the door through which Yagnesh had disappeared.

"No..."

"He's never behaved like that before."

Neither of them understood what had just happened.

But somewhere...

Without anyone realizing it...

Fate had quietly crossed two more paths.

Not every meeting begins with friendship.

Sometimes...

It begins with conflict, confusion...

And unanswered emotions.
